lines.en: label ayanefirsthall:
scene ayanehall1
: Oh? What's this?
lines.zh: : 哦？这是什么？

lines.en: : Take a wild guess, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 随便猜，Ayane。

lines.en: : Did you come all the way over here to propose to me in the middle of the hallway?
lines.zh: : 你大老远跑过来，是要在这走廊正中间向我求婚吗？

lines.en: : Yes. I was brainstorming the most romantic places to do it and I just kept landing on “dorm hallway.”
lines.zh: : 是的。我在脑子里搜罗最浪漫的地点，结果一遍遍落到「宿舍走廊」上。

lines.en: scene ayanehall2
: Wha...Sensei...
: Do you really mean that?...
lines.zh: : 你是真的这么想吗？……

lines.en: : No? Absolutely not. On what planet would that actually be true?
lines.zh: : 不是？绝对不是。在哪个星球上那会是真的？

lines.en: scene ayanehall3
: I was kind of hoping it would be Earth...
lines.zh: : 我本来还希望是地球……

lines.en: : No, Ayane. But, while I'm not here to propose to you, I am here to hang out.
lines.zh: : 不，Ayane。不过，虽然我不是来求婚的，我是来跟你待一会儿的。

lines.en: : So I suggest you stop pounding on your door for a second and, I don't know, pay more attention to me or something.
lines.zh: : 所以我建议你先别砸门了，那个……多关注关注我什么的。

lines.en: scene ayanehall4

: Sensei, you know there's no one in the world I'd rather pay attention to than you. But I promised Sana I'd wake her up around this time and it's already like, ten minutes after the time she gave me.
lines.zh: : 老师，你知道这世上我最想关注的人就是你。可我答应过 Sana 这会儿叫她起床，而且现在都已经比她给的时间晚了十分钟。

lines.en: : Why not just go inside? It's your room, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 为什么不直接进去？那是你的房间吧？

lines.en: : It is. But I think that in an effort to sleep longer, Sana's subconscious may have forced her out of bed to lock the deadbolt on the door and now I can't get in.
lines.zh: : 是。不过我想，为了能多睡一会儿，Sana 的潜意识可能逼她爬起来把门反锁了，现在我也进不去。

lines.en: : Which, of course, means that I must repeatedly knock until my mission is complete.
lines.zh: : 这当然意味着我必须一直敲，直到任务完成。

lines.en: scene ayanehall4r
: Ayane, you know I have a key that controls both locks on the door, right? I can let you in if-
lines.zh: : Ayane，你知道我有一把能开这扇门两道锁的钥匙吧？我可以让你进——

lines.en: : I'm sorry, Makoto. But this is something I must handle on my own.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Makoto。但这件事我必须自己解决。

lines.en: : Uh...I guess if that's what you think is best...
lines.zh: : 呃……我想如果你觉得那样最好……

lines.en: scene ayanehall1
: Oh! I know! After Sana wakes up, what if all three of us did something together?
lines.zh: : 哦！我知道了！等 Sana 醒了，我们三个一起干点什么怎么样？

lines.en: : Something like what, exactly? Because I was kind of hoping to be alone with you.
lines.zh: : 具体比如什么？因为我本来还希望能跟你单独待着。

lines.en: scene ayanehall5
: Oh?
: I mean, that's not how I meant it. But I enjoy that face, so you are free to interpret it that way and act in accordance to whatever you believe I want.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我不是那个意思。不过我喜欢你这张脸，所以你尽管按那个方向理解，并照你以为我想要的方式行动。

lines.en: : Oh, I know what you want.
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道你想要什么。

lines.en: : I am still right here-
lines.zh: : 我还在这儿呢——

lines.en: : Can it, Makoto. This is a moment between me, Sensei, and possibly Sana if we can get her to wake up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Makoto。这是属于我、老师，以及如果我们能把 Sana 叫醒、可能还有 Sana 的时刻。

lines.en: : I'm sorry, what was that last part?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，最后那部分你说什么？

lines.en: : It's her room as well, Sensei. We can try to ignore her if we want, but chances are she's going to notice once things really start to get going.
lines.zh: : 那也是她的房间，老师。我们想无视她也可以，不过等事情真的发展起来，她多半会注意到。

lines.en: : Maybe I should be the one to knock instead? I'm stronger.
lines.zh: : 也许该换我来敲门？我力气大。

lines.en: scene ayanehall5r
: Sensei! I was obviously kidding! Sana is a sweet, delicate flower and I could never let you defile her innocence like that!
lines.zh: : 老师！我刚才显然是在开玩笑！Sana 是一朵甜美娇嫩的花，我绝不会让你那样玷污她的纯真！

lines.en: : I'm going to go talk to Makoto instead.
lines.zh: : 我还是去跟 Makoto 说话吧。

lines.en: : Oh, no. I've tried to interject twice now and it's exceedingly clear that I am not a welcome participant in this conversation.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。我已经两次试图插话了，很明显我在这段对话里不受欢迎。

lines.en: : You're not going anywhere, Sensei! Apologize for your lewd fantasies about my sleeping roommate!
lines.zh: : 你哪儿都别想去，老师！为你对我熟睡室友的下流幻想道歉！

lines.en: : I was literally just playing off of your suggestion. I am a human being and, when tempted with certain things, I am going to act in a human way.
lines.zh: : 我字面意义上只是在接你自己的话往下演。我是个人，被某些东西诱惑时，我就会以人的方式行动。

lines.en: scene ayanehall6
: I know...I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道……我知道……

lines.en: : It only makes sense that you'd want {i}both{/i} of us at once since we are equally adorable and loving and kind and soft and-
lines.zh: : 你想要我们{i}两个{/i}一起也说得通，毕竟我们同样可爱、同样多情、同样善良、同样柔软，而且——

lines.en: : The point, Ayane. Get to it.
lines.zh: : 重点，Ayane。说重点。

lines.en: : Sorry. I think what I'm trying to say is that as much as I understand the...need for more than one partner, I was kind of hoping you'd think otherwise.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我想说的是：虽然我理解那种……需要不止一个伴侣的欲望，但我还是有点希望你的想法不是那样。

lines.en: : I know {i}I'd{/i} be happy with only you, but...you're a guy, so...
lines.zh: : 我知道只有你一个{i}我{/i}就会很幸福，可是……你是男的，所以……

lines.en: : You know that not all guys are interested in just...racking up their body count, right? There are plenty of men who are happy with only having one partner.
lines.zh: : 你知道不是所有男人都只对刷「人数」感兴趣吧？有很多男人只有一个伴侣也很满足。

lines.en: I'm just not one of them.
lines.zh: 我只是不是那种人。

lines.en: It would sure make things a lot easier if I was, though.
lines.zh: 不过我要是那种人，事情会容易得多。

lines.en: scene ayanehall1
: Really? Then I can keep you all to myself and it will be completely justified?!
lines.zh: : 真的？那我就可以把你完全占为己有，而且还完全合理？！

lines.en: : I mean...I'd prefer if you didn't treat me like property {i}when we are literally just acquaintances.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}我俩字面意义上只是熟人{/i}，我希望你别把我当所有物对待。

lines.en: I look over at Makoto to-
lines.zh: 我看向 Makoto，想——

lines.en: : I already told you, I want no part of this. I'm not even listening anymore.
lines.zh: : 我已经说过了，我不想掺和。我甚至都没在听了。

lines.en: That's just what she wants me to think.
lines.zh: 那正是她想让我以为的。

lines.en: scene ayanehall4r
: Alas...reduced from future wife to mere acquaintance in one, brief conversation.
lines.zh: : 唉……一场简短的对话里，就从未来妻子降级成了区区熟人。

lines.en: : Stop assigning yourself roles you never earned.
lines.zh: : 别再给自己安你从没挣到的角色了。

lines.en: scene ayanehall1
: Anyway, I’m glad you dropped by, Sensei. I just wish it was under more fun circumstances and that I could actually get inside of my room.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我很高兴你顺路过来，老师。我只是希望时机更好玩一点，而且我能真的进得了自己的房间。

lines.en: : But hey! Now you know where I sleep in case you ever want to come spy on me at night.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿！现在你知道我睡哪儿了——万一你哪天晚上想来偷看我呢。

lines.en: : Remember, though. If you {i}do{/i} decide to do that, do it on a night Sana is working.
lines.zh: : 不过记住了。如果你{i}真{/i}要那么干，挑 Sana 上班的晚上。

lines.en: : I don't even want to imagine the sort of panic attack she'd have if some mysterious man showed up in the middle of the night and started taking pictures of me.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不想想象，要是半夜冒出个陌生男人开始拍我照片，她会恐慌成什么样。

lines.en: : It would be more concerning if that was a situation she wasn't fazed by.
lines.zh: : 要是她对那种情况毫无反应，那反而更让人担心。

lines.en: : Well, it wouldn't be the first time something like that has happened.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那种事也不是第一次发生了。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : You don't know my life.
lines.zh: : 你不懂我的人生。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
scene ayanehall4r
: I guess we’ll just have to reschedule our “alone time” for another day, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我想我们的「独处时间」只能改天再约了。

lines.en: : I swear, at this rate, Sana won't be putting {i}any{/i} work into our science fair project and I'm going to have to win all on my own yet again.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，照这个进度，Sana {i}一点{/i}都不会为我们的科学展项目出力，我又得全靠自己赢一次了。

lines.en: : Science fair project?
lines.zh: : 科学展项目？

lines.en: scene ayanehall6r
: Mhm! For the science fair you were supposed to tell us about but then forgot to.
lines.zh: : 嗯！就是你本该告诉我们、结果忘了的那个科学展。

lines.en: : I took care of it for you, Sensei. You're welcome.
lines.zh: : 我替你处理好了，老师。不用谢。

lines.en: : I thought you weren't listening?
lines.zh: : 我以为你没在听？

lines.en: : I'm not.
lines.zh: : 我是没在听。

lines.en: : The only issue is that what Sana and I are working on is top secret and the government could send assassins after us if they knew anything about it.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，我和 Sana 在做的事情属于绝密，要是让他们知道一点风声，政府可能会派刺客来追杀我们。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I'm assuming that means you can't give me any details?
lines.zh: : 我猜这意思是你不能给我任何细节？

lines.en: scene ayanehall7
: All I can tell you is that it’s supposed to bring the dead back to life.
lines.zh: : 我只能告诉你，它应该能让死人复活。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: scene ayanehall0
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

What?
lines.zh: 什么？
